recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. If the PC incubator ClinicalAssessment artifact reintroduces a code element, verify that external IG separately; no current core source change is indicated for FHIR-11165.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive Patient Care request asked to change the DSTU2-era ClinicalImpression.code short description from "Kind of impression performed" to "Kind of assessment performed" because the code categorizes the assessment, not the outcome impression.
initial_application: Commit bd9f60dbffee762fd2b3e49ee2e07e232b9685a9 applied the change on 2016-10-28 by updating the ClinicalImpression spreadsheet short name and definition from impression to assessment. The checked-in release3 history shows ClinicalImpression.code with short "Kind of assessment performed" and definition "Categorizes the type of clinical assessment performed.".
additional_context: The current source/fhir.ini active [resources] list omits ClinicalImpression and ClinicalAssessment. Current ClinicalImpression and ClinicalAssessment source files have no code element, FHIR-46596 later renamed the resource to ClinicalAssessment, and the current resource guide links ClinicalAssessment to the external PC incubator IG rather than a core resource page. Community searches found no FHIR-11165-specific Zulip or Confluence discussion and no conflicting wording rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the historical core artifact already reflects the requested wording and the target element is outside current core build scope.

related_jiras.note: Renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment for R6 and helps explain why the original ClinicalImpression artifact is no longer active in the current core build.
Appeared in one later Confluence minutes hit about ClinicalImpression.code binding; it does not affect the FHIR-11165 wording audit and was not decided here.
